name: @jumentix/cana
description: Cana — offline-first IndexedDB database client for Jumentix, in pure TypeScript.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit false && bun run build:esm
scripts.lint: echo "cana: covered by the root eslint run"
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run clean && bun run build
scripts.build:esm: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --format esm --target browser
